data_description.update_interval: A shorter interval increases API traffic and may cause quota errors or temporary restrictions.
data_description.fetch_energy_history: Off by default. When disabled, historical consumption data is not requested at startup, on reload or periodically. Live system data and controls remain enabled. Changing this checkbox reloads only this account.
data_description.update_interval_daily: Used only when energy history is enabled. A shorter interval increases API traffic and may cause quota errors. When left empty, periodic energy history updates are disabled; this alone does not disable the startup request.
data_description.fetch_rts: Not supported by every system. This is separate from energy history.
data_description.fetch_mpc: Not supported by every system. This is separate from energy history.
data_description.fetch_connection_status: Uses a separate API request. Gateway Online does not require this option.
data_description.dhw_legionella_protection_temperature: This is a diagnostic indication threshold, not a setting for the boiler disinfection program.
